body.purpose: Metadata, controls, explanations, and dialog copy.

narrative.overview: A stable TDesign platform shell surrounds a purpose-built light professional workspace. Brand green carries selection and primary action; dark color is isolated to the medical image viewports.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent 56px GlobalHeader with supplied PNG logo and fixed task-tab geometry.
TDesign platform surfaces with a centralized CliniVol green theme.
Light professional menus, tools, data panels, and properties around four dark image viewports.
Explicit saved, dirty, returned, pending-review, and locked states.

rules.name: The Header Does Not Move
rules.body: Page and task changes only replace content below the 56px GlobalHeader.

rules.name: Dark Belongs to Images
rules.body: Only medical image viewports use dark backgrounds; professional chrome remains light.

rules.name: State Has Text
rules.body: Every semantic color is paired with a readable status label.

rules.name: Professional Is Not SaaS
rules.body: The reconstruction workspace uses compact software menus, ribbons, trees, viewports, and property panels rather than dashboard cards.

sections.layout: A fixed 56px header sits above independently scrolling platform or professional content. The professional body uses a Series rail, flexible four-view grid, and object/property rail.
sections.colors: #0D7A5D and #2F9D78 override TDesign brand tokens; semantic warning, error, success, and information colors remain distinct.
sections.typography: Segoe UI Variable with Chinese Windows fallbacks keeps the application native to its primary environment.
sections.components: TDesign owns platform primitives. The professional workspace is purpose-built and only reuses basic buttons, tooltips, and dialogs.
sections.doDont: Use the supplied logo and light shell; do not invent clinical capabilities, redraw the logo, or restore a dark application frame.
